instruction: A candid studio photograph, taken in a full shot from a slightly high angle. In a minimalist indoor studio with a white background and floor, three friends sit huddled tightly on the floor. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3), in a white shirt and blue jeans, leans forward laughing with her head down. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2), in a white top, denim jacket, and black pants, laughs with her head tilted. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1), in a white shirt and blue jeans, laughs with her eyes closed. They are locked in a joyful, tangled embrace, hugging each other tightly under bright, soft studio lighting.
